We need to implement function sortVowels(s: str) returning a string where consonants remain same positions, vowels sorted in nondecreasing ASCII order (i.e., normal character ordering). Vowels include both lower and upper case: 'a','e','i','o','u' and uppercase versions.

Algorithm: iterate string s, extract vowels into list, sort list by ascii value (which default sorted does). Then produce result: iterate again over s, if char is vowel, pop from front (or index pointer) of sorted vowel list; else keep char.

Complexities: O(n log n) time due to sorting; O(n) space.

Edge cases: uppercase/lowercase ascii values differ: uppercase letters have lower ASCII codes than lowercase letters; but we need sorting by ASCII, not case-insensitive. So sorted() will give correct order.

Implementation details: define set vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU').

Implementation of Solution class with method sortVowels.
